comment: Take this for a visual arts gen ed!! It's super easy and didn't require a lot of work. We also only met like once every 2 weeks which was really nice. If you have an issue with any of the programs, Dana is always available to help. Dana is also super understanding and just a great prof!

Prof Olletsad is a great film teacher. He was always very clear with expectations and was quick to help when editing, coming up with ideas, or using film equipment. I had no prior experience with all the software we used and by the end I had a pretty good understanding of it. I enjoyed the projects and the class a lot. Hes a pretty funny guy, too.

Dana was a solid professor. He had minimal assignments throughout the semester and gave a lot of time in class for us to take pictures and work in the darkroom. The film process was tedious and took a while to perfect, unless you got lucky on your first couple of tries. The worst part was that you don't know your grade the entire semester.
